Section heading.
cairn is an editor-first, git-backed CMS and a SvelteKit toolkit a developer extends, built as one.
Content lives as markdown in the organization's own repository.
Every publish is a commit under the writer's name.
History, attribution, and rollback come from git itself.
The writer never sees the git machinery.
The admin is also a toolkit: a developer's own screen mounts inside it, sharing its components and sign-in.
What gets built next reads as one product, not a second app beside the CMS.
